LESSON: CREATING AND

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: MUSICAL
Topic 11.1: Creating and

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Creating and. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Play simple percussion instruments for fun store materials

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Play simple percussion instruments for fun store materials
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to play simple percussion instruments for fun store materials. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Creating and.
2. Explain Creating and to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Guide learners to; 1. What percussion RHYTHM composing leaner should be able to:
4. Show that you can: Play simple percussion instruments for fun store materials
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Creating and. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Creating and important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Guide learners to; 1. What percussion RHYTHM composing leaner should be able to:
2. Practice playing simple use? c) Play simple percussion percussion instruments in pairs 3. How do you play instruments for fun and in small groups. different percussion

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Play simple percussion instruments for fun store materials

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
